g.text: Memory, mapper time and shaping time are separate metrics; no inferred full 16APSK throughput

g.text: A: matched 60 s descriptors: 2.0110 → 2.0107 cycles/symbol; table memory halves while CPU work stays unchanged.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #27343e

g.text: B: normal 5/6 + pilots, 128 MHz; recorded call averages. C: 32,768 data symbols, 128 MHz, flash cached; last bar changes pulse and quantizer.

g.text: 24 cy/symbol = 150 MHz / 6.25 Msym/s before output/control/FEC. All component CRCs match; this is not a full 16APSK modem qualification.
